operations.title: Run C#
operations.summary: Run *code* in this editor as the body of a method, as the next snippet typed into a console.

code.description: C# statements (System, System.Linq, System.Collections.Generic, UnityEngine and UnityEditor are imported); `return x;` hands x back. `Vars` (a Dictionary<string, object>) keeps values for later calls until the editor's domain reloads.

operations.title: Check the Unity project
operations.summary: This editor and project: the Unity version, the render pipeline, the packages, whether the scripts compile and the unitytk serving it, each problem an issue.

operations.title: An image of the scene
operations.summary: An image of the scene: a render of the open scenes to a PNG in pythontk's temp root, with the scene left as it was (no camera, object or setting kept).

objects.description: The objects to frame, by name or hierarchy path, from the front-right above (default: every renderer). Ignored with *camera*.

camera.description: A camera to look through (its object's name or path) instead.
